mapper.select: SELECT script_sha256 FROM ad_billing_schema_history WHERE version=3
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_budget_reservation(traffic_class,reservation_id,quote_id,advertiser_id,ad_id,subject_key,budget_date,amount,expires_at,state,created_at,updated_at) VALUES('SANDBOX',#{reservationId},#{quoteId},#{advertiserId},#{adId},#{subject},#{day},#{amount},#{expiresAt},'PENDING',#{acceptedAt},#{acceptedAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT advertiser_id,budget_date,limit_amount,held_amount,charged_amount,version FROM ad_budget_account WHERE traffic_class='SANDBOX' AND advertiser_id=#{advertiserId} AND budget_date=#{day} AND currency='CNY' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_budget_reservation SET decision=#{decision},state=#{state},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE reservation_id=#{reservationId} AND traffic_class='SANDBOX' AND state='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ad_budget_reservation WHERE traffic_class='SANDBOX' AND reservation_id=#{reservationId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ad_budget_reservation WHERE traffic_class='SANDBOX' AND state='HELD' AND expires_at <= statement_timestamp() ORDER BY expires_at,reservation_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_budget_reservation SET state='CAPTURED',close_reason='IMPRESSION_CAPTURED',closed_at=#{acceptedAt},updated_at=clock_timestamp(),version=version+1 WHERE traffic_class='SANDBOX' AND reservation_id=#{reservationId} AND state='HELD' AND version=#{version}

UPDATE ad_budget_reservation SET state=#{state},close_reason=#{reason},closed_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE traffic_class='SANDBOX' AND reservation_id=#{reservationId} AND state='HELD' AND version=#{version}
